INSERT INTO learning_ai_async_task_step (id, task_id, step_code, step_name, step_order, status, completed_count, total_count, checkpoint_json, lease_token, lease_until, heartbeat_time, attempt_count, max_attempt_count, error_message, started_time, finished_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted, version) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.taskId}, #{item.stepCode}, #{item.stepName}, #{item.stepOrder}, #{item.status}, #{item.completedCount}, #{item.totalCount}, #{item.checkpointJson}, #{item.leaseToken}, #{item.leaseUntil}, #{item.heartbeatTime}, #{item.attemptCount}, #{item.maxAttemptCount}, #{item.errorMessage}, #{item.startedTime}, #{item.finishedTime}, #{item.createBy}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateBy}, #{item.updateTime}, #{item.deleted}, #{item.version})
mapper.update: UPDATE learning_ai_async_task_step SET status = 'running', lease_token = #{leaseToken}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, heartbeat_time = #{now}, started_time = COALESCE(started_time, #{now}), attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, error_message = NULL, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{stepId} AND status = 'pending' AND deleted = 0

UPDATE learning_ai_async_task_step SET status = 'pending', lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, error_message = '执行进程中断，系统已从当前步骤恢复', update_time = #{now} WHERE status = 'running' AND lease_until < #{now} AND deleted = 0
